title: Arrays and Objects (Intro)
description: Working with lists of data using arrays.

lessons.title: What is an Array?
lessons.content: An array is an ordered collection of values, which can hold multiple items under a single variable name. Arrays allow you to store lists of data like numbers, strings, or even other arrays.

lessons.title: Accessing Array Elements
Array Length
lessons.content:
console.log(fruits.length); // 3
// The length property returns the number of elements in the array.

lessons.title: Introduction to Objects
lessons.content: Objects store data in key-value pairs, allowing you to represent real-world entities with properties and values. They provide a way to group related data and functions together.
